retained_candidate.title: On-site 3D scanning / reverse engineering for large, immovable or no-drawing industrial parts
retained_candidate.why_reopened: Scan 007 closed generic no-drawing reverse engineering because mature national providers already existed. A new 2026-09-08 Xuzhou Daily report now supplies direct local evidence that nearly ten Xuzhou manufacturers were interviewed and local enterprises had reverse-engineering demand but difficulty finding local providers. That is material new evidence for a local/on-site residual, not a reason to reopen generic reverse engineering.
reality_change: Portable industrial 3D scanning makes large/immovable equipment measurable on site without full disassembly.
Xuzhou manufacturing and engineering-machinery density creates recurring physical objects whose drawings may be missing, damaged or unavailable.
Local specialized supply is emerging but still young.

actor_a.type: Xuzhou manufacturer / engineering-machinery owner needing one-off on-site scan, deformation capture, no-drawing reconstruction or repair model
observed_demand_evidence: 徐州多帮三维科技 reports surveying nearly ten local manufacturers before launch; the survey concluded local enterprises had reverse-engineering demand but struggled to find providers.

The same firm reports real customer work including large-tonnage engineering-machinery deformation-repair scanning/modeling, Mercedes-AMG body-part scanning/modeling/3D-print trials, and a 17m large-component project.

Real local projects already connect physical industrial assets to scanning/modeling services.
Regional providers market on-site scanning for large equipment that cannot easily be removed.
current_workaround: find a local scanning/reverse-engineering provider directly
call a regional provider to travel to site

retained_candidate.missing_edge: POSSIBLE but NOT OBSERVED strongly enough for P0: occasional local manufacturers with large/immovable/no-drawing parts may still lack a low-friction way to define the scan/model task, find available field capture capacity, route modeling work, enforce accuracy/format acceptance and settle without building the capability in-house.
retained_candidate.minimum_service_unit: one on-site industrial object scan plus bounded reverse-model deliverable

rooter_execution_map.task_definition: object/location/access + size/material/surface + required accuracy + output STEP/IGES/CAD/point cloud + repair/manufacturing purpose + confidentiality/IP boundary
rooter_execution_map.executor: qualified scanning provider and/or remote reverse-modeling engineer
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: agreed scan accuracy, coverage, file format, usable CAD/STEP/IGES deliverable and fit/geometry check where applicable
rooter_execution_map.operator_role: standardize intake, route local capture and modeling capacity, QA acceptance, settlement and performance history
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally scan, model or sell consulting hours

reachability.supply_side: A/B — multiple named Xuzhou/regional providers are publicly reachable
reachability.demand_side: C/UNBOUND — real local projects exist but no named current payer event with workaround cost is publicly bound

mobilization.hard_gate_reason: The strongest local provider explicitly reports that online acquisition performed poorly and growth required targeted industrial-park visits. That is direct evidence against a self-propelled demand pump.

self_propulsion_counterevidence: 徐州多帮三维科技 says it tried online technical-service platforms intensively but generated only about RMB 7000 in revenue over six months, with proceeds largely consumed by acquisition.
The company then shifted toward local industrial-park connection and targeted visits.
This suggests the service business can be real while the Rooter platform thesis remains weak.

cheapest_decisive_reality_probe.reason: No named demand actor with a recent paid workaround and no non-founder demand pump are yet bound. Calling factories now would still be discovery-by-outreach.
cheapest_decisive_reality_probe.public_research_next: Find a named Xuzhou manufacturer/equipment owner with a recent outsourced on-site scan/reverse-engineering event, actual time/cost/decision path, and evidence of how the buyer found the provider. Determine whether demand naturally enters through repair/MRO/search/procurement channels or requires provider-led industrial-park sales.

kill_conditions: Local providers already solve on-site scan + reverse modeling directly at acceptable speed and price.
Most buyers who need the service repeatedly simply buy scanners or build internal capability.
Customer acquisition requires targeted factory visits or founder/provider education for each project.
After one successful job, buyer and provider bypass any routing layer and no recurring QA/availability value remains.
Task confidentiality/IP or technical scoping is too bespoke to standardize.
promotion_conditions: One named Xuzhou demand actor has a recent paid on-site scan/reverse-engineering event with measurable workaround time/cost.
At least two replaceable providers accept the same bounded intake and acceptance schema.
A recurring non-founder inbound source exists, such as repair/MRO events, procurement/search demand or partner channels.
Rooter adds recurring availability/QA/acceptance value beyond introduction.
The transaction can be completed without Rooter doing scanning/modeling or one-by-one enterprise sales.

scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Bind one named Xuzhou buyer's recent outsourced on-site reverse-engineering event and its actual acquisition/workaround path. The decisive question is not whether demand exists; it is whether demand self-propels into a routable channel and whether Rooter adds non-bypassable value after local providers already exist.
